newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends up, led by Lujiazui.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends up, led by Lujiazui.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended up on Tuesday led by Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co Ltd with market sentiment strong on institutional buying, brokers said.
The index rose 1.206 points or 1.75 percent to 70.305 points on volume of 23.1 million shares worth $11.0 million, up from Monday's $9.6 million.
Brokers said the index is likely to rise further in the short-term on follow-up buying boosted by the rises in the past few days.
"The market has broken the 68-point resistance level and a cautious rise is expected in the short term," one broker said.
"The index is likely to rise further in the coming days on follow-up buying mainly in shares which haven't moved much over the past few days," a second brokers said.
All 43 B shares traded, with 34 up, three flat and six down.
Shanghai Lujiazui traded the most on institutional support, rising $0.024 or 2.72 percent to $0.904 on volume of 2.7 million shares.
Glass maker Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington 600918.SS was the star on a rebound, jumping $0.032 or 7.92 percent to $0.436 on volume of 340,200 shares.
Shanghai's A share index closed up on speculative buying in selective stocks, but the potential for further rises is limited on possible profit-taking, brokers said.

The A index gained 10.254 points or 0.89 percent to 1,160.645 points on volume of 773.1 million shares worth 87.2 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index rose 30.130 points or 1.02 percent to 2,972.273 points.
Gold producer Luyin Industry Group was the star on talk of a plan to issue bonus shares, jumping 2.05 yuan or 10 percent to its limit-up of 22.50 yuan on volume of 2.3 million shares, brokers said.
